Name: Portrait for Sylus stardew NPC
Author: Ballarina
Description:
This is a portrait mod for Sylus Stardew NPC (LADS) by halostar2332.
This requires the [Portraiture] mod to function.

How to install:
1. Install Portraiture: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999
2. Install Sylus Stardew NPC (LADS):https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33146
3. Download this mod.
4. Unzip this mod into Stardew Valley Mods-Portraiture-Portraits folder in your files.

Cycle through the portraits in-game using the P key, and you should be able to see it.
If you want to use this mod with other portrait mods, you could take the [Sylus.png] file and put it in the folder with the other portrait mods you wish to use.
It should look something like: Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Sylus(Or other portrait mod folder)/Sylus.png.

_____________________________________________________________________________________________________

这是一个给Sylus stardew NPC制作的肖像模组！只有肖像，没有其他部分。
这个模组需要[Portraiture]才能正常显示。

如何下载：
1.下载Portraiture: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999
2.下载Sylus Stardew NPC (LADS):https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33146, 或者汉化版该模组: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33308
3.下载这个模组。
4.将这个模组解压到：星露谷物语-Portraiture-Portraits文件夹中。

在游戏里按P键循环肖像，显示[Sylus]的时候应该就可以了。
如果你想同时使用其他肖像模组：你可以把[Sylus.png]放到其他肖像模组的文件夹中。
路径应该是: 星露谷物语/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Sylus(或你的其他肖像模组文件夹)/Sylus.png。
